problem: If $P(x)$ and $Q(x)$ are polynomials of degree $7$, what is the highest possible degree of $P+Q?$
worked_solution:
The highest possible degree of $P+Q$ is $7.$

For example, suppose $P={x}^{7}$ and $Q={x}^{7}.$ Then $P+Q=2{x}^{7}.$ 

Since neither $P$ nor $Q$ contain terms of order higher than ${x}^{7},$ $P+Q$ can't contain terms of order higher than ${x}^{7}.$
